image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small weasel (likely a stoat or short-tailed weasel in summer coat) peeking through tall green grass. The animal has reddish-brown fur on its head and back, transitioning to white/cream on its chest and underside. Its face is visible with dark eyes, a small nose, and rounded ears. The body is partially obscured by the foreground vegetation.
